message.content: Keysight Technologies sells design, emulation, and test solutions that span the full product lifecycle to technology innovators, with customers across AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company reports its business in two segments, the Communications Solutions Group and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group [D1]. In the quarter ended July 31, 2026, the Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1.35 billion, up 43.09 percent from the prior year, and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million, up 21.60 percent [D1]. Total revenue for that quarter was $1.85 billion [D1].
